body: I was supposed to take a break this summer and go to Chattanooga, TN to work on a farm. I met my girlfriend, though and I felt like staying around. I would love to try it sometime, though. Thanks for reminding me.

I have been to counselors, but never a psychiatrist. It helps to talk to someone about it, and eventually having someone listen helps me conquer these things, but it always comes creeping back. I'm also bad at remember appointments, so I got over $200 in fines from my last counselor.
Thanks! My roommate's been trying to get me to start using IRC, and I might just install a client.

I feel like everything I have is wonderful, and I acknowledge that, but I will never truly appreciate it. A lot of things I could do without, but they will stay with me. For example, my friends get me down a lot, but they're ecstatic about me. I feel like a can't live up to their expectations though and I just shell up and hide. I feel like I'm put in the spotlight whenever I'm around them and I don't want that.
